map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton and Morrow publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-11-04 04:00): mail returned 15,377 (state 14,712); early in person 43,074 (state 43,072). Clermont (as of 2026-11-04 06:34): mail returned 12,992 (state 12,686); early in person 19,198 (state 19,069). Crawford (as of 2026-11-03 08:54): mail returned 2,005 (state 1,959). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-11-03 22:40): mail returned 111,747 (state 108,618); early in person 54,042 (state 53,903). Franklin (as of 2026-11-04 00:12): mail returned 75,683 (state 72,363); ballots sent 82,923 (state 82,847). Hamilton (as of 2026-11-02 20:04): early in person 77,694 (state 77,693). Morrow (as of 2026-11-03 21:16): mail returned 1,417 (state 1,360); early in person 3,669 (state 3,667).
